thread:
alexa: Quick idea  "Sparkling Thanks" pop-up next Thursday 3:30-4:30pm in the atrium: cookies (incl. vegan) + small printed thank-you cards that double as spot-award slips ($20). Low-effort, brightens the week. Who can help run? :cookie:

people-ops: Sounds lovely. Micro-event budget is $500. Need vendor quote + event owner. We'll confirm payroll treatment, and require recipient tracking if there's an award value.

jamal: I can take 3:30-4:00 and handle cookie pickup. I know a bakery (CornerBakes) that does a mixed box for $85 for 100 mini cookies.

ops-bot: /reminder set "Confirm CornerBakes quote" for @alexa tomorrow 10:00

tara: I can staff 4:00-4:30 and bring a card tray + stickers. I can also make a simple RSVP form.

payroll: Quick note: non-cash items under de minimis thresholds are usually fine, but we still need to log recipients and item value. If any individual's total awards exceed $100 in a year, we'll need to report. For the event, capture recipient email + award label should suffice.

alexa: Great. Plan: print 75 cards labeled "Spot Award $20" and 25 plain thank-you cards so we don't push awards to everyone. Will mark award cards so we have a record.

people-ops: Please hold language for the invite until payroll confirms exactly what to say. Draft blurb for now: "Small spot awards will be tracked and may be reported per company policy." We'll tighten tonight.

jamal: logistics checklist:
```
- confirm CornerBakes + pickup time
- print 100 cards (75 thank you + 25 spot-award $20 labeled)
- volunteers: jamal 3:30-4:00, tara 4:00-4:30
- RSVP form & dietary options
- submit invoice to #expenses
```

ops-bot: spot-awards-bot: Tip: during the pop-up use `/spot-award @person <reason>` to auto-log winners.

tara: RSVP form URL (draft): https://forms.company/sparkling-thanks (will add dietary and shipping opt-in for remote folks)

alexa: remote folks  we can ship a small cookie kit or an e-gift. Shipping kits cost ~$8 ea. I'll add an opt-in in the form.

people-ops: If we ship kits, capture addresses via secure form and mark shipping cost as expenses. Also keep a CSV of recipients for payroll.

jamal: I submitted the vendor quote to #expenses. CornerBakes confirmed pickup at 3:15pm.

payroll: Confirmed wording for invite: "Small non-cash spot awards and recognition items will be tracked and reported per payroll policy when required." That's short and transparent.

people-ops: Perfect. Final actions:
- alexa: place card print order + confirm pickup details
- jamal/tara: staff shifts
- people-ops: publish invite with payroll blurb and RSVP link
- alexa: submit receipts to #expenses after event

alexa: Thanks all! Excited to try this small activation. :sparkles: :cookie:
